families.finding: The Rotom MIT grant is already limited to original project work and excludes third-party Pokémon/PTU material.
The project is non-commercial and unofficial, but that notice is not permission to redistribute third-party material.
Canonical runtime data plus retained documentary/parser trees contain third-party PTU-derived material outside the Rotom grant.

Most Pokémon/item/trainer art has no explicit redistribution license; 29 files lack upstream provenance and 1,460 edited trainer-profile derivatives conflict with the source index do-not-edit warning.
Three Fontsource families produce 18 runtime binaries under OFL-1.1 and require attribution/notice preservation.
971 lock-bound instances: zero unknown after one reviewed MIT metadata override, zero mandatory copyleft conflicts, with MPL, attribution, and one permissive dual-license review set.
Direct licenses are known, but minimum-version requirements do not freeze exact versions or the future transitive graph; certifi is a known MPL family.
Current notices state ownership boundaries but do not yet enumerate Fontsource, PokéSprite, PokémonDB, Pokémon Showdown, or trainer-artist provenance.

releaseGate: Every family requires an explicit owner disposition at P13-062; potential-blocker findings cannot be silently accepted by automation.
